item.title: Scp 5133
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes
Page Type: Scp Article
Elevator Pitch: Scp 5133 gets contained for an anomaly that has is blocked by personnel, as any description of appearance or behavior will cause the people involved to worship Scp 5133.

Central Narrative: Site 138 staff had all fallen into Scp 5133's memetic ability, no replies had been filed to site fund managers, two mtf operatives go to try to contain any escaped anomaly's after believing that site 138 had suffered a containment breach. They arrive and all scp's are contained except Scp 5133 where they report that it is memetic. Perfect containment cant be made as the original anomoly can be discovered and cared for if no information can be learnt.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The archived containment procedures are not what anyone would expect, as it states any personnel showing disliking to Scp 5133 are to be terminated via incinerator, and the archived description has been blocked by upper site command.

Additional Notes: Site 138 is just a random number I picked so finding a site that stores anomalies that could have been corrupted by a memetic hazard. And a site that can house things you dont know.

item.title: Re: Rabes Opinion
item.content:encoded:
I really liked the fact that it wasn't clear. This forced the reader to concentrate on the characters and plot. The beauty of SCI-FI is that you can address these issues by changing the situation without changing the question. (Eeh, it sounds so two-dimensional, but I hope you understand what I mean.) Also the point that our culture and the way we treat our bodies does not automatically apply to other life forms is very real and makes it more interesting to see how we interact. This reminds me of "The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet", a fantastic book that I only recommend to you.

I'm sorry I'm so late replying, but I swore I wouldn't write a reply until my story was finished, which it is now after more than a year! I'll try to translate it and put it in INT and maybe EN.

item.title: [Seeking Greenlight] Host of the Eldritch Abomination.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:** Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Elevator Pitch: A teenager name "Janual Grey" that one day discovers that he's no longer human after an unexplained blackout while he and his friends are at Acadia National Park, and later on woke up and finds himself as a space, time, and reality-altering eldritch abomination.

+ show block
– hide block

Janual still acts like a regular human. However, discovering his powers has made a few changes. He begins to possess numerous anomalous properties that not even he knows how many does he has. Every 24 hours passes by. If Janual doesn't consume any food that gives him the nutrition he needs, he will get driven into a state of absolute hostility, where he would go on a never-ending frenzy to satisfy his hunger, which of course that time he would begin to use more of his anomalous properties to lure humans deep into the woods. Which is why he usually lures bad peoples into his territory and consumes them.


Central Narrative:
+ show block
– hide block

The main point here is that:

Janual wasn't actually a human at all. Janual was originally born like this already. His father was a cosmic eldritch deity worshiped by a cult named "Servants of "Darkness" " secretly built under a church where his mother as a nun is, the cult mainly focuses on worshiping a deity named "Darkness". When the cult let his father manifest into reality, he disguised himself as a handsome human and seduced his mother into having a child. After borning out Janual, he de-manifested himself out of reality to let his son, Janual, destroy the world instead of him. However, due to embodying human natures, Janual didn't become malevolent as his father was.

After a few years, when Janual's mother has raised him, she had witnessed him consume their neighbors in his monstrous form. As she started to find answers to why her son is like this, she soon discovers the truth. She could find a way to seal his powers from being unleashed due to worrying that he might bring apocalyptic events. However, during the past years, she slowly forgets that she must check and renew the seal.


Hook/Attention-Grabber: Janual is a friend in school with SCP-105 and is familiar with SCP-4051 as they've met each other before being held in Foundation custody.

Additional Notes: Draft is almost finished.

item.title: Unvirtual Reality
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article. Several experimental test logs added as well.

Genre: Sci-fi, Parallel Universes

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a computer program that one day appeared and automatically installed in every computer at site-XX. If run it will display the message "SCP Breach Simulator- Site XX Edition" and then create a realistic simulation of site XX, were you will play as yourself and will have to survive a SCP breach.

Central Narrative: Any computer brought into site-XX will manifest the program inside of their files, even if the computer was completely cut out from the internet and any other method of networking. SCP-XXXX cannot be deleted but any computer that is taken outside of the site will have the program erased from its files. SCP-XXXX will work on personal computers and laptops; smartphones, tablets, servers and mainframes won't manifest the program inside of their files. On the other hand anything that classifies as a personal computer, regardless of its model, year of manufacture or Operating System will manifest and be able to run the program. Older models will create more crude simulations, with very old computers generating text based descriptions and allowing the users to chose how to act with input prompts and more modern computers generating 3D environment that can even be compatible with Virtual Reality technology.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention Grabber: The program manifested after a particularly sudden and gruesome containment breach. In that breach agent XXXX mentioned how it felt as if her actions were not her own, but chosen and forced upon her by someone else. It is believed that the simulations that the SCP generates are not simulations at all, but live feed from a parallel universe where a breach is occurring. Players from this universe take control of their versions from the universe that is being shown in the computer, and the simulation will run until the breach is contained, the SCP escapes or the "player" dies. It is believed that after running a simulation SCP-XXXX will automatically install in every computer of site-XX of that particular parallel universe, spreading itself further and further.

The foundation can choose to use the SCP to conduct breaching simulations or even spy in parallel universes and steal research or information that might help their cause, but at the cost of damaging another SCP foundation from a parallel universe and spreading the SCP more and more. The more the SCP has spread the higher the chances are for the Foundation of this universe from becoming another "simulation" and suffering a breach.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: Vague Memories
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mystery

Elevator Pitch: Documents, people, writings, anything infected with the SCP becomes very unnaturally vague, but doesn't cause any other harmful side effect.

Central Narrative: The phenomena is referred to as "Vagueing" or "The Vague".

The SCP isn't a state of matter, nor does it exist physically, rather it's a strange unknown phenomena that spreads from person to person, only when they share ideas, brainstorm together, etc. It effects a person's speaking, and causes them to speak rather vague.

Not only does it effect humans, but also effects documents and anything written by "Vagued Men". Such infected manuscripts include a lost SCP-001 article, and the "11th" commandment. It has the same exact effects, causing very slurred and vague text.

The SCP does not have any other side effects, and only causes slurring in speech, and unnatural vagueness, no nausea, no coughing, no death, nothing like that.

Hook/Attention Grabber: Basic idea yet has a lot of interesting details when it comes to "documents lost to the vague".

item.title: The White Glove's Limousine
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights : Yes

Page type : SCP Article

Genre : Drama/Mystery/Horror?

Elevator Pitch :

- An SCP that takes the form of a Mercedes-Maybach S600 Pullman Guard

- It usually appears in a handful of locations between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m, especially when the streets are crowded.

- The SCP will “target” a person out on their own, from the crowd, who will then feel obligated to seek out the car. Upon the target’s approach, a single hand wearing a white glove will emerge from the interior of the vehicle and will gesture for them to get inside.

- Once the person does so, the door will close violently. The car will then start moving again.

- It will disappear after 25 minutes of driving. A hypnotic effect distracts any human observing the car for too long after its departure. Recording the vehicle is impossible.

Narrative :

+ show block
– hide block

In 2010, the Foundation received reports of a series of mysterious disappearances around the Sydney Opera House, the Wynn and Encore complex, and the Théâtre de Paris. After long months of investigation, the dispatched agents discovered the source of the disappearances : a black limousine, presumed responsible for abducting the missing persons.

In order to determine its properties, it was deemed necessary to dispatch observation teams to all the destinations at which the anomalous limousine had been spotted. The O.T. located outside the Théâtre de Paris was the first to spot the limousine;, at 8 p.m, on the 19th of may 2010. Although the doors of the vehicle were opened upon arrival, its interior was impossible to observe due to a lack of light inside the car. A few minutes later, a Caucasian man in his 20s entered the limousine. The door then seemed to shut itself violently, and the car immediately took off. Attempts at following the object were always unsuccessful : after an average of 25 minutes of observation, any agent following the car experiences a brief moment of inattention, during which the vehicle escapes from view. Filming the vehicle also seems to be impossible : all video records in which the limousine appears seem to be heavily disturbed, and hence impossible to watch. If any person other than the target gets within arm’s reach of the vehicle, the doors will immediately clamp shut, and the car will flee the scene. To this day, this is the only known way to prevent further abductions by the object.

Attention-grabber : The mysterious limousine and disappearances.

Additional notes : None

item.title: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello Jabobai! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's great to see you are as fascinated with the SCP Universe as we are here on-site. Hopefully your future readings won't disappoint you and will only make the feeling of wonder even greater. It also seems like you really want to contribute to the site, which I am very happy for; I can't wait to see what you come up with!

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.title: Quasi-Rewrites
item.content:encoded:
SCP-4166 began as what was essentially a rewrite of SCP-166. It was posted in a different slot while the original still existed, but used a lot of the same text and described a very similar entity to 166, if not a reinterpretation of the same one. This seems to have been done with the permission of the original author, however, based on the discussion posts.

I am asking because there's an old SCP from Series 1 that seems generally unpopular now but I think has potential. I would like to rewrite it, but it has too many old upvotes to meet the standard rewrite criteria and the original author, as far as I'm aware, is long gone. Could I do something similar to 4166 and post an SCP that is essentially the same thing but modified to tell a different story and fit current writing standards, or is that plagiarism if done without the original author's consent?

item.title: Re: Temporal Hula Hoops.
item.content:encoded:
I have never heard of 4122 up until this point, but I agree it is probably far too similar.

I apologize if my explanation wasn't very good, it made sense in my head at least.

Easy explanation:

Things that pass through the hoop are transported back in time exactly 10 minutes, consider the hoop being half blue and half red, passing through the red side will result in you emerging on the blue side, just as a normal hoop, but you will be 10 minutes in the future, an observer from the future would just see you coming out of the blue side of the hoop, it's not a magic teleportation thing, it's a smooth transition, think of it as a portal from the game portal, but the orange and blue sides are fastened together, you can clearly see through the orange side and see out of the blue side, the only difference being is that the light hitting your retina is the light that traveled through the hoop 10 minutes ago.

if you go in one side, you come out the other side, 10 minutes in the past or future, I don't know how to explain this simpler.

+ show block
– hide block

Having multiple hoops is only a thought I had while considering this, and the test I described was just an example I came up with.

Hard explanation:

Also with the multiple realities thing, I made this decision due to the fact that if I didn't it opens a whole can of worms with time paradoxes and stuff, I can thoroughly explain how the multiple realities work, this does not mean that the foundation can, the foundation will not know exactly how this object works.

Consider the following: 3 dimensions of space and 2 of time, the first dimension of time is the normal one we are moving through all the time, "right" on the "time-plane". If you were a 5-dimensional being you could look to the left and see the past, and look to the right to see the future. in time, seconds are used as the measurement, looking one second to the right is one second into the future, and one second left is a second into the past, the 5th dimension is the "up" and "down" of the time plane, the Y-axis, if you, a 5-dimensional being, were at the origin of this plane, and then looked 1 second up, you would be seeing another timeline which is 1-second offset from the original one, such that the instance 1 second above 0,0 is the same thing as the instance 1 second to the left of 0,0.

if you were to move diagonally through the time-plane (that is, equal amounts in two dimensions) from 0,0 to 1,1 there would be no apparent change in space or time, therefore, the instances of space at points X,X in time are all the same, 10 minutes is 600 seconds.

let's say that the hoop is in point 0,0 of space (height arbitrary) and is also in point 0,0 of time, if the hoop is left alone for 10 minutes it's new time coordinate would be 0,600.

The function of the hoop is to transport an object passing through it 600 seconds up in time and to the point in space where it was 600 seconds ago.

Consider this, the hoop exists at 0,0 Space, 0,0 Time, 600 seconds later it is at 10,0 Space, 0,600 Time, this means that over the course of 600 seconds it has moved 10 space units up and 600 time units to the right. An object (an infinitely small point) passes through the hoop, such that the exact second that it is inside the threshold of the hoop is 0,600, in the next instant it will then have 600 added to it's up/down time coordinate, it's coordinates are now 600,600, we have previously established that all points on a diagonal line going in the +x and +y direction are exactly identical, this means that point 600,600 is identical to point 500,500, and every point X,X a point in time that can be expressed by X,X is the point in time 0,0.

The object would therefore appear to be at the point 0,0, which from its perspective, was 600 seconds (10 minutes) ago, it has not traveled through time as we know it, but through the second dimension of time.

The object has also traveled through space, remember that the hoop was at 0,0space at 0,0time, meaning that as the object emerges through the hoop, it will be at point 0,0space at 600,600time, so that is where the object will be in space when it emerges.

if the SCP obeys the logic I've described, paradoxes will not happen.

With any non-infinitely small object which is made of many subatomic particles, the same process would be undertaken on all of the particles as they pass through as well.

This is my most thorough explanation of the way this SCP functions.

The foundation does not possess the tools to investigate this deeply into the way this SCP functions, and will only have a general ballpark of how it works.

I hope this helps explain it.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: Re: My first SCP article
item.content:encoded:
considered how many demon goat images we tend to use and figured this was where it came from.

Satan's appearance is, to my knowledge, never described in the Bible. The goat imagery largely comes from dark ages and medieval monastic writings, which was likely actually targeted at then-contemporary European pagan rites1.

I mean there are four Biblical SCPs in the first 100

Standards were much lower at the time those were written. Few of them would survive if posted today, and using them as a guideline is likely to lead to failure.

Footnotes
1. Cf. Cerunnos and various other horned deities.
